correctness.rationale: An independently constructed C16(1,2,6) has 48 edges and exactly 260 independent faces with dimensions (16,72,112,60). Reconstructing the 16-position deterministic toggle matching yields 127 matched pairs and critical cell dimensions (0,1,3,3,3,3), with an acyclic 720-incidence Hasse orientation. Its Morse CW model has a single one-cell and four three-cells, whose S² attaching spheres map trivially into S¹ (π2 S¹=0), giving S¹∨4S³. Exhaustive adjacency-preserving permutations give exactly D16 (32 elements). The 15-edge-support integer 1-cocycle is closed on all 112 triangles, primitive on the specified five-edge cycle, and every rotation/reflection action yields degree-one character ε. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz calculations yield four-dimensional H3 character equal to Q(zeta8), with rotation traces 4,-4,0 and reflection 0. Rational invariants vanish in H1 and H3, hence orbit cohomology rationally acyclic. All finite graph and character universes were exhausted, not sampled.
